title: How to Get Rid of Hiccups Fast
description:
Molly demonstrates how to get rid of hiccups fast by placing a knife in a cup of water. The dull end of the knife is placed against the forehead and then tilted back while drinking. 

This is a fast easy way to get rid of hiccups. What are your techniques for getting rid of hiccups? Please leave your comments below.
author: Phillip and Molly
